verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a public web API with an official machine-readable OpenAPI spec, plus API-level issue operations such as bulk mutation. A CLI and an MCP server also expose API access for agents. Nothing shows the API matches the UI feature for feature, and the docs note some endpoints are beta and subject to change. missing for 10: explicit documented UI-to-API parity, evidence that areas like dashboards, alerts, Seer and replay are fully API-operable, stable (non-beta) coverage across all endpoints, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
